info.title: Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers
info.synopsis: Dopo il declino di scienza e tecnologia, una nuova fonte energetica nota come "magia" alimenta l'epoca moderna. L'umanità arriva così a creare delle armi biologiche proibite, i Gears, che a un certo punto si ribellano. Il genere umano sopravvive al conflitto, ma con perdite enormi, con ferite anche emotive che nemmeno con i decenni trascorsi si sono completamente rimarginate. In questo contesto, Sin Kiske, figlio di un umano e di un Gear, si reca al matrimonio dei suoi genitori, considerabile per certi versi come un'eresia, e infatti persino in un mondo oramai in pace sono serviti molti anni per poter celebrare le nozze. All'improvviso, appare una misteriosa ragazza, che detesta i Gears... l'incontro tra il figlio di una simile unione e la ragazza sconvolgerà il mondo.

episodes.title: Cerimonia
episodes.synopsis: Sin va al matrimonio di Ky e Dizzy, ma una sconosciuta irrompe nel castello e attacca i presenti.

episodes.title: Fede nella pace
episodes.synopsis: Sin e Sol si recano in USA, dove si terrà la cerimonia per commemorare la fine della guerra coi Gear.

episodes.title: L'angelo che ha messo le ali
episodes.synopsis: Elphelt cerca di scoprire chi ha attaccato la barriera, mentre Sol e Sin arrivano in USA e trovano Unika.

episodes.title: King of Gears
episodes.synopsis: Sin confronts his failures, Unika questions herself, and the true enemy's identity begins to surface.

episodes.title: La decisione del Re
episodes.synopsis: Nerville ricorda il suo passato, mentre Sin, Sol e gli altri arrivano finalmente alla sua residenza.

episodes.title: Un visitatore dal futuro
episodes.synopsis: Mentre i Gear di tutto il mondo si risvegliano, Sin cerca di contrastare il virus di Nerville.

episodes.title: Sole nero
episodes.synopsis: Sin e gli altri uniscono le forze per cercare di fermare la distruzione causata da Nerville del futuro.

episodes.title: La tua vera forma
episodes.synopsis: Sin e Unika si alleano e lo scontro finale con Nerville ha inizio.

info.title: Gatchaman Fighter (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Dopo la presunta distruzione definitiva del Leader X alla fine di "Gatchaman II", un suo frammento sopravvissuto si rigenera mutando in un'entità chiamata Z. Alleatosi con il Conte Egobossler, capo della famiglia Egobossler (affiancato dai suoi sottoposti Mechandol e Kempler), Z intende portare a compimento la distruzione della Terra e annientare una volta per tutte la Squadra Ninja Scientifica.

Nel frattempo, a seguito della morte di Anderson, il Dr. Nambu assume la guida dell'ISO. La squadra, ora di base a Gallatown (soprannominata "G-Town"), una struttura sottomarina, viene affiancata dall'ingegnere Kamo. Quando il nuovo GodPhoenix viene distrutto nelle prime fasi dello scontro, il team riceve il Gatchaspartan, un mecha avanzato dotato di una modalità speciale – l'Hypershoot – accessibile solo a Ken grazie alla sua nuova spada, il Gatchafencer.

Con il procedere della serie, però, si scopre che l'Hypershoot emette radiazioni letali: l'uso prolungato sta lentamente uccidendo Ken, e continuare significherebbe condannarlo a morte. Nel frattempo, Z mette in atto il suo piano definitivo: colpire la Terra con un asteroide di antimateria, ribattezzato "Poison Apple".

episodes.title: New Dark Clouds
episodes.synopsis: Weeks after the dust settles from Sosai X's destruction, a tiny fragment of the alien revives and begins to rebuild itself into Sosai Zed. Using the remains of an old shipyard, Zed builds a vast mechanical pyramid fortress and levitates it over the ocean. Meanwhile, the rest of the world quits rebuilding from the wreckage of the thwarted Solar Shift Plan and go back to what they do best: waging war. We meet Count Egobossler, successful ruler of a growing number of territories, and an aspiring megalomaniac. Egobossler meets Sosai Zed, who decides to use Egobossler's brilliant military tactics to his own advantage, and the two strike a deal. In the wake of Chief Anderson's death in Gatchaman II, Nambu is promoted to Chief Administrator of the ISO. The Kagaku Ninjatai cope with the unusual peace. Feeling useless during peacetime, Joe wallows in boredom and self pity while Nambu tries to find a way to recharge him after his near-destruction in G-II.

episodes.title: Debut! Gatcha Spartan
episodes.synopsis: Egobossler's first attack, backed up by one of Zed's giant mechs, completely startles out heroes. Ken, Jun, Jinpei and Ryu rush to the scene of the battle (leaving Joe behind to quietly expire). The mech is too powerful, and the New Godphoenix is completely trashed in the first skirmish with Egobossler. Fortunately, Chief Engineer Saburo Kamo is waiting in the wings with brand new mechs. With only one problem: the new vehicles need five operators to combine. It's up to Joe, who upon hearing the phrase, "Gallactor has returned," will crawl on his final strength to rejoin the team. TheGatchaspartan saves the day.

episodes.title: The Challenge of the Iron Commandos
Burn! Gatchaman Fencer
episodes.synopsis: Ken asks the same question viewers have probably been asking since the beginning: "Enough battling the little guys--why can't we meet Egobossler head on?" The Team does, but fails miserably. This episode ends in a very disturbing role reversal scene with Ken--now beyond reason--raging at a laughing Egobossler, and Joe finally having to bring all his strength into play to drag Ken back into the Gatchaspartan.

episodes.title: Steal the Giant Iron Beast
episodes.synopsis: The Kagaku Ninjatai continue their tries at direct confrontation by stealing aboard Zed's tower and facing him directly. This doesn't work either (can we say "outnumbered"?), though they do get in a few good punches.

episodes.title: Fear of the Extinction Ray Gun
The Order to Destroy the Mantle Base
A Deadly Butterfly Dances in the Dark
Horror of the Evil Smoke City
Don`t Touch the Super Stuff!
episodes.synopsis: Mercenary scientist Professor Gordon develops an indestructible material called Neophryte and decides to sell it to the highest bidder. So he summons agents from both Gallactor (Egobossler's first officer, Kempler) and the ISO (the Gatchaman, naturally) to meet alone on a spot he specifies. Of course Kempler doesn't come alone, but much to both his and Ken's surprise, neither does Ken. While the Gallactors and the rest of the Kagaku Ninjatai take part in a snarling standoff outside, Gordon, Kempler and Ken negotiate. Kempler offers money, while Ken refuses to haggle, stating honor and decency as his reasons (and knowing as Gordon does that once he withdraws his protection, Gallactor will simply take what they want by force). Worried about his father, Gordon's son finally ends the standoff and uncovers the compound for both sides to fight over. Joe uses a bazooka loaded with Neophryte to blow a hole in the monstermech that appears at the end.

episodes.title: Appearance! Terror of the Triple Iron Beast
Angry Joe! Fright of the Flaming Bird
Sky Riders from Hell
episodes.synopsis: One of Egobossler's old friends and colleagues Oncain, is also the last man on Earth who knows Count Egobossler's deep, dark secrets. The Kagaku Ninjatai get to Oncain first and try to convince him to stay away from Egobossler, but the man will have nothing of it. He invites the Team to go fox-hunting and with his two children, Michael and Mary, and as they're distracted, arranges to meet with Egobossler. The inevitable showdown with Egobossler and his special Skyrider command is spectacular, but even Ken and Joe at their best can't prevent Ego from gunning down his man. Joe comes round the corner just in time as Ego shoots Oncain right before Michael and Mary's eyes (triggering a flashback where you almost see the faces of Joe's parents). In the final scene, Joe kneels down and has a little heart-to-heart talk with Michael. You don't hear what he says, only Michael's reactions.

episodes.title: G-1 Enraged! A New Way to Kill
Cruelty! The Separation of Brother and Sister
The Shadow of Death Approaches G-1
Surprise Attack of the Mecha Waterspout
Gatchaman Eternal
episodes.synopsis: The Team searches for Zed in his tower, and are thrown around like playthings. When they finally meet up, they discover what happened to Egobossler: his corpse is pinned against a wall in Zed's main chamber, run through by his own sword. At this point, Joe picks up on Zed's vital signs (as Rafael had designed him to) and tracks the alien to his last refuge, where the Kagaku Ninjatai battle to destroy him... and fall. Chief Nambu's mysterious pendant (an unanalyzed device he'd instructed Kamo to give to the Team before the last battle) comes into play then, activating the Gatchaspartan and swallowing the fallen ninjas with light... The final scene is of an enormous firebird breaking free of Zed's exploding tower and flying around the Earth, leaving us to analyze the wide open ending. (Chances are high, though, that they aren't dead--they're still under contract, after all.)

info.title: Renkin San-kyuu Magical? Pokaan
info.synopsis: La serie narra le bizzarre avventure di quattro ragazze molto particolari: Yūma la strega, Pachira il vampiro, Liru il licantropo e Aiko l'androide. Principesse di un altro mondo, decidono di avventurarsi in quello degli umani finendo per abitare in una casetta abbarbicata su un grande albero. La loro vita sarà un constante susseguirsi di situazioni comuni e non, una più divertente dell'altra.

episodes.title: The First Spell Is an Easy Trap / The Afternoon Spell Is a Red Cub
episodes.synopsis:
A. Dr. K-Ko has devised traps that end up catching Pachira, Liru, and Aiko. Thus, Uma ends up coming to the rescue.

B. After seeing the postman deliver letters, Uma tries to build a mailbox so that the girls can receive mail.

episodes.title: The Spell of the Moon Is a Blood Pedigree / The Make-believe Spell Is TV Shopping
episodes.synopsis:
A. Following an incident at the prehistoric mammal section of the museum, Liru discovers love when she meets a man named Ryo who turns out to be another werewolf.

B. Uma discovers the home shopping channel on TV, starting a shopping frenzy in the tree-house. Later, the girls discover what bills are.

episodes.title: Tomorrow`s Spell Is a Blood Donation of Love / The Spell of Happiness Is an Ideal Man
episodes.synopsis:
A. Pachira falls in love with the young man who works on the blood donor bus. Maybe if she donates all her blood he'll return her feelings?

B. The girls visit a theater and discuss their ideal boyfriends. After getting trapped in the elevator on their way out, they continue their discussion while waiting for a rescue.

episodes.title: The Secret Spell Is a Storm Front / The Spell of Relativity Is Tanabata, the Star Festival
episodes.synopsis:
A. The rainy season has come and Aiko's circuits are covered in mold. While Liru plays in the rain, Uma and Pachira try to repair Aiko's systems.

B. A heat wave has struck the city and the girls learn about Tanabata. They ponder and discuss what wishes they should make for the holiday.

episodes.title: A Tiring Spell Is a Trip to the Beach / Love`s Spell Is a Trip to the Beach
episodes.synopsis:
A. When a typhoon ruins their day at the beach, Uma is unable to disperse it with her magic, so the girls try to invent their own beach experience at a nearby hotel.

B. Following an accident with their floats, the girls are saved from drowning by Lulu, the princess of the merfolk. Lulu wants some help in return, though.

episodes.title: The Spell of Rebirth Is a Search Through Hell / A Healing Spell Is a Park Debut
episodes.synopsis:
A. Uma takes a tour of Hell.

B. Uma ends up performing magic tricks in the park to entertain people.

episodes.title: A Richly-Flavoured Spell Is the Night of the Full Moon / A Combining Spell Is the Invincible Robot, M5
episodes.synopsis:
A. Liru is excited about the upcoming viewing of the Full Moon.

B. In this Super Robot-type segment, Uma, Pachira, Liru, and Keimie act out as Magical 5 to save Aiko and their fuel company from a giant Mecha-Hongo robot created by Dr. K-Ko.

episodes.title: Tonight`s Spell Is a Vampire / The Spell of Dreams Is Magic That Lasts Only One Day
episodes.synopsis:
A. People are being attacked by a vampire and Liru suspects Pachira for the attacks. Pachira fights to prove herself innocent by finding the real culprit.

B. Aiko orders Happy Chalk which can bring anything that's drawn to life. Since it can only work for a witch, Uma uses it to draw various things including drawing up a galactic train to take them to the Andromeda Galaxy.

episodes.title: The Spell of Breaching Is Inviting a Love Interest Home / The White Spell Is Christmas
episodes.synopsis:
A. While out buying baked yams, Liru saves a handsome young man from being beaten up, but when she accidentally transforms to her wolf form she has to flee before he notices. Later, Aiko invites the man to the tree-house so he can thank Liru, but Pachira has her own plans...

B. The girls prepare for Christmas by preparing stockings and a Santa-sized chimney.

episodes.title: A Cold Spell Is Snowboarding and Skiing / A Hot Spell Is a Natural Hot Spring
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls hit the slopes and learn how to ski. When they fail to make a reservation at one of the lodges, they end up staying with some snow people.

B. The girls find a hot spring and end up encountering women who turn out to be a group of Tanuki that end up stealing the girls' clothes.

episodes.title: The Spell of Reticence is Having Fun with English Conversation / A Pinch Spell is the Other Side of "Goodbye"
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls play a "speaking English" game hosted by Keimie and a mess-up has them drinking the bad-tasting Natto drink.

B. The girls see Dr. K-Ko on a TV show explaining her theory that horror movie monsters existing amongst the human race. When the co-host of the TV show ends up discovering the girls' secret thanks to footage used by Dr. K-Ko, the girls end up arguing to defending themselves against K-Ko on a TV talk show.

episodes.title: A Sorrowful Spell Is When One Is Transformed by Memories / A Kind Spell Is a Magician
episodes.synopsis:
A. Aiko finds a VCR that contains her memories as a rerun of the girls' favorite show is airing. When they plan to use the VCR to tape it, they end up needing D/A Converter to hook it up to their Digital Television.

B. When Uma ends up with an infection, she ends up getting the other girls infected with her magic. With her magic perfected, she practices it on the town. After curing herself and the other girls of their infection, they soon work on a spell to make a Cherry Blossom Tree bloom early.

info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Call of the Night

episodes.title: That Time`s Not for Us.
episodes.synopsis: A new night begins as the other vampires offer to help Ko and Nazuna with their relationship. But what they really want, however, are the deets.

episodes.title: I`ve Been Looking for You.
episodes.synopsis: Ko's alarm bells go off when he meets Mahiru's new friend. Mahiru may not know what Kiku is, but Ko does.

episodes.title: There Aren`t Any Ghosts in a Haunter House.
episodes.synopsis: A tense confrontation with Anko reveals an alarming secret: vampires have a weakness they didn't know about. Now, they all must decide their next move.

episodes.title: Do You Want to Be Able to Run?
episodes.synopsis: Some patients say Room 307 is haunted, and Kabura warns Ko and Nazuna to stay away. Something's in that forbidden room. Something that might hold the key to the past.

episodes.title: The Few Years I Spent with You...
episodes.synopsis: Kabura thought she'd be with Haru forever. But life never goes according to plan, even for vampires. Now Kabura is left with a burden she never asked for.

episodes.title: I`m Not Asking About the Quality!
episodes.synopsis: With Anko closing in, the vampires must destroy the source of their weakness before she can find them. Midori's search leads Ko and Nazuna to someone... unexpected.

episodes.title: You`re Too Stupid for That.
episodes.synopsis: When Ko finds the diary of a girl called Kyoko, he discovers that he wasn't Nazuna's first human friend. Nor the first person she ever considered turning...

episodes.title: You`re the First, Senpai.
episodes.synopsis: What began as Kyoko and Nazuna's investigation into a supposed affair led to a life-changing event that altered their relationship forever.

episodes.title: Yamori-kun, What Do You Want to Do?
episodes.synopsis: Vampires cannot be harmed by conventional means, so what does Anko hope to accomplish by shooting them out in the open? Ko suspects there’s a method to her madness.

episodes.title: I Wanted It to Be You.
episodes.synopsis: As the battle between vampire and hunter erupts, Ko finally realizes the full scope of what's at stake. Now he must stop both Anko and Nazuna before it's too late.

episodes.title: Mwah...
episodes.synopsis: Something's wrong. Or maybe too right. Ko isn't a vampire, so why does it feel like his body's ignoring the rules? He and Nazuna need answers.

episodes.title: Call of the Night
episodes.synopsis: Growing up doesn't guarantee answers to life. As Ko wonders what it means to be ordinary, he and Nazuna venture through the city. Where will the night take them this time?

Quando un misterioso gatto di nome Pallas appare nel loro bagno, li trasforma nei Haikara Romantic Group, un gruppo di “Battle Lovers” con poteri magici grazie a speciali braccialetti. Ora devono affrontare il Bankara New Elite Corps, un gruppo di studenti del consiglio scolastico che punta a imporre un controllo rigido e autoritario sulla scuola.

Why are you blurring out the names? It's a multi-verse setting, so mumble mumble... episodes.title: The Twit-Tree Is Hi-CARA!
episodes.synopsis: Once a month, Binan High School's Handsome Boys Contest is held as a regular event. Since entering the school, Sukayu Narushi has been winning the contest in a row, and is a beauty guru recognized by both himself and others.

episodes.title: Being Hi-CARA at the Swimming Contest!
episodes.synopsis: Summer has arrived in Mayunan City! Mayunan High School's traditional long-distance swimming competition is to be held at Otokoran Beach, and the Defense Club and other students are in high spirits.

episodes.title: Be Hi-CARA at the Ninja Village!
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation has begun at Binan High School, and Aso Sorata returns home with the gluttonous Oshamanbe, whom he caught with mountain delicacies. Waiting for them in their hometown are Aso's three younger brothers.

episodes.title: Being Hi-CARA on the Crab Cannery Ship!

info.title: Swallowed Star
info.synopsis:
Un giorno, il virus RR di origine sconosciuta appare sulla Terra, scatenando un disastro globale. Gli animali infetti mutano in mostri spaventosi e attaccano su larga scala. Di fronte all'imminente distruzione, gli esseri umani costruiscono muri e fondano città come ultimi bastioni dell'umanità. Le prove che il genere umano affronta in questo periodo vengono chiamate "Periodo Nirvana".

In un ambiente di vita così estremo, la forza fisica umana si evolve gradualmente, fioriscono le arti marziali e le capacità fisiche raggiungono livelli qualitativamente superiori rispetto al passato. I migliori tra loro vengono chiamati "Guerrieri". Il diciottenne Luo Feng sogna di diventarne uno. In procinto di affrontare l'esame di ammissione all'università e una scelta cruciale per il suo futuro, un improvviso attacco di mostri ne altera il destino.

episodes.title: Episode 01
episodes.synopsis: The RR virus has brought monsters, and mankind has entered the era of Nirvana. In the case of the fall of many countries, only five major countries survived, formed the Earth Alliance and established bases. The main reason for the survival of human beings is that warriors were born among human beings under the influence of RR virus antibodies. Back to 5 years ago, Luo Feng, who was born in a low-rent area, decided to take the college entrance examination in order to realize his dream of becoming a martial artist. That day, Luo Feng met Xu Xin on the street and was about to talk to him. At this time, a flying alien appeared in the sky...

episodes.title: Episode 02
episodes.synopsis: After Luo Feng left the school gate, he was besieged by Zhang Haobai, a senior martial arts student, and three others. Luo Feng was in excellent physical condition and fell three people down in a few strokes. The next day was the college entrance examination. Luo Feng left early, and was actually blocked by a group of punks. It turned out that Zhang Haobai had come to hold Luo Feng to prevent him from taking the college entrance examination. Although he was overwhelmed, Luo Feng was still late. Thanks to Mr. Jiang’s help, Luo Feng was allowed to take the exam...

episodes.title: Episode 03
episodes.synopsis: The simulation location of the Quasi-Martial Artists assessment is set in the old world, which mainly assesses the strength, speed, survivability and the number of monsters killed. Luo Feng passed the assessment with the first overall quality ranking, and also won the quasi-martialist award-the gene source energy training method, and the actual combat assessment is scheduled for the first of next month...

episodes.title: Somehow or Another, I`d Like to Get Out

episodes.title: I Want to Hand Out Gifts to Everyone

info.title: Marriage of God & Soul Godannar!!
info.synopsis: Cinque anni fa, mentre combatteva contro una forza aliena conosciuta come “Mimesis”, il pilota Dannar Goh Saruwatari incontrò per la prima volta Anna Aoi. Oggi, nel giorno del loro matrimonio, la cerimonia viene interrotta quando i Mimesis attaccano di nuovo. Mentre Goh lotta contro la minaccia aliena, Anna si imbatte in un robot top secret chiamato “Neo-Okusaer” e lo usa come ultima risorsa per salvare il suo fidanzato. In quel momento, Dannar e Neo-Okusaer si fondono per diventare il potente robot “Godannar”.

episodes.title: Wedding Bell of the Battlefield
episodes.synopsis: Five years ago, while battling an alien force known as the "Mimesis," Dannar pilot Goh Saruwatari first met Anna Aoi. Today, on the day of their wedding, the ceremony is interrupted when the Mimesis strike again. As Goh struggles in his battle against the alien threat, Anna stumbles upon a top secret robot known as the "Neo-Okusaer" and uses it as a last-resort to save her fiance. At that moment, Dannar and Neo-Okusaer merge to become the mighty robot "Godannar."

episodes.title: Blazing Virgin Road
episodes.synopsis: As Anna begins her rigerous training as a robot pilot, she and Goh also try to adjust to their first days of living together. After a silly argument which has Anna go into town to blow off some steam, the mimetec they fought last week appears, attacking Anna directly.

episodes.title: Battle Royal Honeymoon
episodes.synopsis: When a Mimetec appears in the South China Sea, robot teams from several nations gather to battle it. Meanwhile, Anna and Goh vow to battle together through thick and thin.

episodes.title: Shizuru`s Comeback
episodes.synopsis: Shizuru begins to question if she belongs on Dannar base any longer, especially after Goh and Anna are hurt in battle. But after encouragement from Anna, Shizuru's confidence is rejuvinated and she, Anna, and Goh defeat the latest Mimetec threat.

episodes.title: A Girl from the Sky
episodes.synopsis: When Astro Base is attacked by a Mimetec, Lou is forced to eject to Earth while her father stays to protect the base. When Lou and Goh return to the base to keep it from crashing in Earth, they end up fighting the Mimetec to avenge Lou's father.

episodes.title: Death by Reminiscing
episodes.synopsis: The newly revived Max steals Myra away, leading to a confrontation with Goh, whom he blames for losing her in the first place.

episodes.title: The Graceful Shooting Star

episodes.title: The Castaway Survival
episodes.synopsis: After the fighters crash on an island, Dannar Base begins to send out rescue ships. Go, Anna, Knight, and Ellis inspect the damage to their robots. Okusaer and Dannar can move, but the jetboys are heavily damaged, so the four of them are stuck there.

episodes.title: Lou`s Sortie
episodes.synopsis: When a new space station launch is reported, Lu becomes even more despondant. However, she soon finds someone to channel her underlying hatred for Mimetic beasts.

episodes.title: A Flawless Departure
episodes.synopsis: Lu is reprimanded for her actions while Goh encounters the rogue mech pilot.

episodes.title: Those Who Have Departed
episodes.synopsis: With Godannar and Neo-Okusaer out of commission, the only one to challenge a new Mimetic threat is Shizuru.

episodes.title: Last First Kiss
episodes.synopsis: While the base reels at the loss of one of their own, Anna continues to sort things out.

info.title: Onegai☆Teacher: Himitsu na Futari
info.synopsis: Kei e Mizuho stanno attraversando un periodo difficile nel loro matrimonio, e la famiglia di Mizuho decide che è giunto il momento di andare a trovarli.

episodes.title: Secret Couple
episodes.synopsis: Hatsuho and Maho visit and force Mizuho to talk about intimate moments with Kei. Hatsuho kidnaps Kei, takes him to a love hotel, and ties him to a bed. Although Hatsuho is sexually attracted to Kei, it is actually an attempt to add excitement into Kei and Mizuho's marriage.

info.title: The Elusive Samurai 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di The Elusive Samurai

episodes.title: Longing for Sea Bream!
episodes.synopsis: It is the first year of the Kenmu era (1334), in Suwa, Shinano province. Tokiyuki, now fully accustomed to life in Suwa, is reminded of meals from his days in Kamakura during a casual conversation. He recalls how much he loved eating freshly caught sea bream from Yuigahama, seasoned with wasabi and soy sauce from Izu.

episodes.title: Ayako`s Heart-Pounding Operation!
episodes.synopsis: The Ashikaga forces keep a vigilant watch across the country, searching for remnants of the Hojo clan scattered throughout Japan. Sadamune, the governor of Shinano, has grown suspicious of “Chojumaru,” a young warrior who has repeatedly distinguished himself in battle—first during the dog-shooting competition, and later on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Tokiyuki and Three Great Generals
episodes.synopsis: Provincial official Kiyohara returns to Shinano after fleeing back to Kyo following the previous battle. Having grown even more ruthless, Kiyohara launches a large-scale invasion against pro-Hojo factions in northern Shinano. To oppose the combined forces of Kiyohara and Sadamune, the three great generals of the Suwa faith—Nezu, Mochizuki, and Unno, retainers directly serving Yorishige.

episodes.title: The Warrior of Love: Shinano Mask!
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki and his companions race across the battlefield, sparing even the slightest moments of rest in order to relay information to their allies. However, when they arrive at the northern front where Mochizuki and Tokoiwa are fighting, what they witness is a fortress engulfed in flames, falliing into ruin... Ayako collapses in grief as she thinks of her father, Shigenobu Mochizuki.

episodes.title: The Unyielding
episodes.synopsis: The central battlefield descends into total chaos. Just as victory seems within reach for the Hoshina–Shinomiya forces, a new obstacle suddenly appears before them: Kiyohara’s newly devised battle mikoshi. Originally intended as a palanquin for issuing commands from the rear, it is now reinforced with heavy armor.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Became a God
episodes.synopsis: The battle ends in defeat for the Suwa Sect. Although they manage to keep casualties to a minimum, the losses they suffer are significant. As they look toward the next great conflict, everyone in the Suwa Sect comes to share an even stronger resolve. The battle becomes another valuable lesson for Tokiyuki as well—one that helps him grow even further.

episodes.title: My Uncle
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki’s uncle, Yasuie Hojo, is still alive! Once a key figure at the heart of the Kamakura Shogunate, Yasuie survives the fall of Kamakura. Afterward, he travels throughout the Tohoku region, continuing to fight alongside the remaining Hojo loyalists. But after suffering defeat after defeat, he eventually finds his way to Suwa.

episodes.title: Irreplaceable
episodes.synopsis: At the suggestion of Yorishige and Yasuie, Tokiyuki sets out for the capital, Kyo, together with the Elusive Warriors. Major Counselor Kinmune Saionji, an ally of Yasuie, awaits their arrival in Kyo. While Yasuie and Kinmune conduct a secret discussion, Tokiyuki and his companions venture out into the city.

episodes.title: The Man Called Masashige Kusunoki
episodes.synopsis: Having grown closer over a game of dice, Mima invites Tokiyuki and his companions on a tour of Kyo. Even though they know she is the daughter of their enemy, the Elusive Warriors accept her kindness and spend a brief, youthful moment enjoying themselves as ordinary boys and girls. However, upon returning to the Saionji's residence, Tokiyuki and the others are informed of a plan for an uprising.

episodes.title: The Night of the Assassination
episodes.synopsis: Through his dialogue with the warrior Masashige Kusunoki, known as a “god of war,” Tokiyuki is moved by Kusunoki's unwavering convictions and develops an even deeper sense of confidence in the possibilities of “fleeing.” Just as he is smiling over this fortunate encounter, everything suddenly changes when he hears news of his sworn enemy Takauji’s movements.

episodes.title: My Buddha, Part Two
episodes.synopsis: Although the attempt to assassinate Takauji ends in failure, Tokiyuki has grown significantly as a warrior through his experiences in Kyo. Upon his return to Suwa, Yorishige tells him that the time has finally come. The attempted assassinations of both the Emperor and Takauji plunged Kyo into chaos, where warriors from the Kanto area were summoned and the city's defenses were reinforced.

episodes.title: The Age
episodes.synopsis: With preparations for war complete, the Suwa forces are finally about to ignite the great conflict. Tokiyuki is appointed commander-in-chief, taking command of the “Kamakura Party,” a unit formed from surviving retainers of the Hojo clan—while keeping his true identity hidden. Can he prove himself worthy as a leader to those who feel uneasy about serving under a child?

info.title: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too (ITA)
info.synopsis: Eri, ormai studentessa delle superiori, torna a visitare la U.A. High School, il luogo che ha segnato profondamente la sua infanzia. Durante la visita, i ricordi del passato si intrecciano con le nuove sfide del presente, mentre ritrova volti familiari e scopre quanto siano cambiati gli eroi che un tempo l'hanno salvata. Adattamento dell'omonimo one-shot pubblicato nel fanbook del 2025 Boku no Hero Academia: Ultra Age.
